name: HYDRA-UMC
build: 6 independently-versioned components (G474 + H745 CM7 + H745 CM4, app + bootloader each). This registry tracks the G474 application as representative. Real install/build: bash build_firmware.sh.
notes: The real motion-control firmware for this ecosystem's own physical robot arm PCB - 6 independently-versioned MCU targets (G474 + H745 CM7/CM4, app + bootloader each), plus a real CM5-side SPI-OTA bridge (src/cm5_host/spi_bridge/, Python, unit-tested against fakes). This is the project the whole ecosystem exists to control. Maturity is honestly 'experimental': the bootloaders compile clean but are not yet verified against real silicon, the H745 application firmware is still a FreeRTOS smoke-test stub, and no populated board exists for either custom PCB yet (no schematic).
